purpose: Training-only learned-state integration acceptance, not a return comparison or historical CrossQ retry
input_source: Previously verified retained original SAC training replay prefix; first1001 rows; no market data request
recurrent_architecture: Separate observation-only GRU64 for actor, critic1/2, target critic1/2; actor hidden64 ReLU then mean/logstd4; critic hidden64 ReLU with action4 head; no padding, dropout or cached collection hidden states
recurrent_initialization: Fresh seeded native PyTorch construction, saved initial tensors and RNG; target critics copied exactly from online critics; no weight mapping to the feedforward control
native_initialization: Pinned original unfitted full64 SAC seed11 asset; native SB3 2.7.0 SAC; constant original settings
batch_sampling: NumPy default_rng(11), precompute four uniform window batches with replacement from complete within-episode windows; eight windows of32 rows; native control consumes exactly matching128 loss-bearing rows per update
episode_identity: Monotone replay segment ordinal from recorded done masks; source symbol unavailable in replay so segment labels are provenance only, never real-symbol claims or model inputs
state_approximation: Zero-initialized16-row finite burn-in at sampled starts; exact full-history reconstruction is not claimed
acceptance: finite actual gradients for every optimized recurrent parameter
observed entropy critic actor order and no target gradients
exact Polyak arithmetic after every recurrent update
all native Adam counters and moments restored
initial and final actor/critic/entropy state changes
deterministic carried/reset action parity after checkpoint restoration
matching per-update native and recurrent loss-row identities
checkpoint_selection: None; retain initial and final states for both arms; no validation or test evaluation
forbidden: claiming a recurrent performance improvement from smoke losses

execution.failure_policy: One claimed allocation; no automatic restart. Persist original ledger and shared baseline, monitor every minute, bounded artifact retrieval and verified owned cleanup on every outcome. Include setup, idle, downloads and failures.

status_at_registration: No allocation; worker/controller/archive acceptance must pass before execution
